=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:1545-1577,1839-1844,2085-2100,2232-2249,2519-2535 (also scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:3650-3710) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The holder's active-run checks cannot see the judge run that `_mt_dispatch_rb_judge` dispatches through review_rb_judge_dispatch.yml. That workflow has no `[pr:N]` run title, and its head_sha is the default branch head, so neither `_mt_lease_pr_runs_active` nor `_pr_head_ci_runs_pending` matches it. The judge_decision arm also never sets `MERGE_LEASE_GATE_CONFIRMED=true`, so a judge_decision holder can lose its lease and then stay held.
  WHY: If the judge run is still queued or running after MERGE_LEASE_IDLE_MINUTES (default 60), the holder is revoked as revoked_no_head_gate and a soft skip entry is written. That entry clears only when MERGE_LEASE_GATE_CONFIRMED=true, which the judge_decision path never sets, so the PR is logged skip_head_unchanged on every tick. This recreates the deadlock that G3 of #9987 is meant to remove. All three reviewers rated it MAJOR, mapped here to high.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: G3 of issue #9987, "After the grant, the PR reaches a merge or a normal lease release without a person. The granted holder is taken through the judge's merge path ... It must not end in another review round that only labels the PR ai:review-blocked again and waits for stall recovery." The issue also says to build on #9985 once it has merged; a holder on this path follows the #9983 holder rules unchanged.
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_merge_train.sh: the dispatch order or registration in `_mt_dispatch_rb_judge`, and/or the active-run checks in `_mt_lease_pr_runs_active` (line 1810) and `_mt_inflight_review_branches` (line 1302), and/or the soft-entry checks in `_mt_merge_lease_tick` (line 2232, 2232-2249) and `_mt_merge_lease_tick_multi` (line 2523, 2519-2535), and/or the holder revocation path (2085-2100)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: No hunk in the PR diff or the db1385b merge resolution makes the review_rb_judge_dispatch.yml run count as holder activity. That workflow has no `run-name:`, so the `[pr:N]` regex at review_merge_train.sh:1844 cannot match it, and its head_sha is the default branch head. `_mt_dispatch_rb_judge` never registers the PR in `_MT_LEASE_DISPATCHED_PRS`, which is set only in `_mt_release` (line 2929). No hunk lets `MERGE_LEASE_ELIGIBLE_GATE=judge_decision` clear a soft revoked_no_head_gate entry: line 2232 still requires `MERGE_LEASE_GATE_CONFIRMED`, and pr_checks_lib.sh:3709 never sets it. No test in tests/test_merge_lease.py or tests/test_review_merge_train.py covers a judge_decision holder surviving an idle-revocation tick or a judge_decision waiter clearing a soft entry.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:_mt_dispatch_rb_judge (first dispatch `gh workflow run review_rb_judge_dispatch.yml --repo "${MT_REPO}" -f pr_number=...`), _mt_lease_pr_runs_active lines 1839-1844, _mt_merge_lease_tick lines 2085-2100; also scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh lines 3667-3688 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The judge_decision grant dispatches review_rb_judge_dispatch.yml first. That run has no `[pr:N]` title (`name: "Internal: Review-Blocked Judge Dispatch"`, no run-name) and runs on the default branch head_sha, so it matches neither of the #9983 holder active-run rules. Both fallback wrappers carry `[pr:N]`: internal-review.yml line 8 and workflow-templates/ai-review.yml line 11.
  WHY: A judge run that takes longer than MERGE_LEASE_IDLE_MINUTES (default 60) is revoked as revoked_no_head_gate, and a soft skip entry is written. The entry clears only when MERGE_LEASE_GATE_CONFIRMED=true (lines 2232 and 2239), which judge_decision never sets, so the PR gets skip_head_unchanged on every tick and lease_wait again: a deadlock. The reviewer calls this new evidence since rejection iss_0715e442ba6cdce1, because #9985 has now merged at db1385b. Suggested fix: try the `[pr:N]`-titled force_rb_judge wrappers before review_rb_judge_dispatch.yml.
- TASK_GAP | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  Requirement: G3, "After the grant, the PR reaches a merge or a normal lease release without a person. The granted holder is taken through the judge's merge path ... It must not end in another review round that only labels the PR ai:review-blocked again and waits for stall recovery." Constraints: "PR #9985 (for #9983) changes _merge_lease_pr_eligible and both tick loops. Build on it when it has merged."
  Expected change site: scripts/review_merge_train.sh, either in _mt_dispatch_rb_judge (dispatch order) or in the soft-entry checks in _mt_merge_lease_tick (line 2232) and _mt_merge_lease_tick_multi (the matching tm_first_soft condition).
  Evidence of absence: #9985 has merged into this branch (db1385b), but no hunk makes the review_rb_judge_dispatch.yml run count as holder activity. Neither _MT_LEASE_DISPATCHED_PRS nor the `[pr:N]` title test covers it, and no hunk lets a judge_decision waiter clear a revoked_no_head_gate soft entry.
- HARDENING: scripts/review_merge_train.sh, _mt_dispatch_rb_judge dispatch order. Move the `for mt_rbj_wf in ai-review.yml internal-review.yml` force_rb_judge loop ahead of the review_rb_judge_dispatch.yml call, and update the two exact-call test assertions; about 8 lines changed. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
- The reviewer found nothing in the other categories. It noted that `-f allow_workflow_edits=false` on the fallback dispatches narrows capability correctly, and that the arm `""|"pending ${elig_login}"` in scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh lines 3698-3704 is fully quoted, with the login validated at line 3643.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

  WHY: A judge run longer than MERGE_LEASE_IDLE_MINUTES (default 60) gets the holder revoked as revoked_no_head_gate. The PR is then held as skip_head_unchanged because MERGE_LEASE_GATE_CONFIRMED stays false, which is a deadlock.

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- TASK_GAP | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  Requirement: G3 of issue #9987, "After the grant, the PR reaches a merge or a normal lease release without a person." A holder on this path follows the #9983 holder rules unchanged.
  Expected change site: scripts/review_merge_train.sh. The soft-entry clear condition at line 2232 (single-holder tick) and line 2523 (multi-holder tick) must let `MERGE_LEASE_ELIGIBLE_GATE=judge_decision` clear a soft `revoked_no_head_gate` entry. `_mt_lease_pr_runs_active` (line 1810) and `_mt_inflight_review_branches` (line 1302) must recognise the judge dispatch's run as active.
  Evidence of absence: scripts/review_merge_train.sh:2232 still gates on `[ "${MERGE_LEASE_GATE_CONFIRMED:-false}" != "true" ]`, and scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:3709 only sets `MERGE_LEASE_ELIGIBLE_GATE=judge_decision`. `review_rb_judge_dispatch.yml` line 1 has no `run-name:`, so the regex at scripts/review_merge_train.sh:1844 cannot match it, and the run's head_sha is the default branch head. `_MT_LEASE_DISPATCHED_PRS` (scripts/review_merge_train.sh:1815) is set only in `_mt_release` (line 2929). Judge runs of 35 minutes were observed in the #9956 evidence. The PR can loop with judges that keep deciding `terminal`. No test covers this combined scenario: tests/test_merge_lease.py lacks the soft-entry interaction, and tests/test_review_merge_train.py is on the inherited failures list.

- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:`_merge_lease_pr_eligible` lines 3650-3710 (judge_decision arm at 3709), interacting with scripts/review_merge_train.sh lines 2085-2100, 2232-2249, 2519-2535 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A holder granted on the judge_decision path is revoked and then permanently skip-held. The judge run is a default-branch workflow_dispatch titled "Internal: Review-Blocked Judge Dispatch" (`.github/workflows/review_rb_judge_dispatch.yml:1`, no `run-name:`), so `_pr_head_ci_runs_pending` (pr_checks_lib.sh:3660-3688) and the `_mt_lease_pr_runs_active` filter (review_merge_train.sh:1842-1844) both miss it, giving `revoked_no_head_gate` (review_merge_train.sh:2087). MERGE_LEASE_GATE_CONFIRMED stays false, so the soft-entry checks at 2232/2239 and 2523/2528 keep the PR at skip_head_unchanged, and the clearing condition at review_merge_train.sh:2152 cannot be reached.
  WHY: The PR never merges or gets a normal lease release without a person; the D4 unlabel path only hands it to the sweep, whose re-dispatched judge defers again. This recreates the deadlock #9987 G3 was written to remove.
- TASK_GAP | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  Requirement: G3 of issue #9987, "After the grant, the PR reaches a merge or a normal lease release without a person. The granted holder is taken through the judge's merge path ... It must not end in another review round that only labels the PR `ai:review-blocked` again and waits for stall recovery."
  Expected change site: scripts/review_merge_train.sh: the soft-entry conditions at lines 2232-2249 and 2519-2535 and/or the holder revocation path at lines 2085-2100, or `_mt_dispatch_rb_judge` registering its dispatch.
  Evidence of absence: No hunk makes a judge_decision grant visible to the #9983 active-run check: `_MT_LEASE_DISPATCHED_PRS` is set only at review_merge_train.sh:2929. No hunk lets judge_decision clear a soft revoked_no_head_gate entry, since the arm at pr_checks_lib.sh:3650-3710 never sets MERGE_LEASE_GATE_CONFIRMED. tests/test_merge_lease.py and tests/test_review_merge_train.py have no test for either case.
- HARDENING: scripts/review_merge_train.sh, `_mt_dispatch_rb_judge` success paths (~lines 1521-1533). Append the PR to `_MT_LEASE_DISPATCHED_PRS` on each successful dispatch, mirroring `_mt_dispatch_review`; about 2-4 lines changed. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
- The reviewer re-checked two items against the working tree and found no defect in either: the `""|"pending ${elig_login}"` arm and the `allow_workflow_edits=false` fallback dispatches.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
